The '''ii77''' was one of many variants to the standard [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] that was developed and manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. The ii77 droids were considered boutique droids, aimed at a specific market.
